provenance.disclaimer: Simulation/research severity index (0-100) from sensor evidence only; not an ML output and not a certified medical or automotive severity scale. Synthetic data only; no real severity data was used.

training_derived.lo: P99 over TRAINING windows of Normal Driving/Pothole/Hard Braking/Sharp Turn (n=1600): the ceiling of ordinary driving and routine events
training_derived.hi: P90 over TRAINING windows of Minor/Severe Accident, Rollover, Multi-Impact (n=1600): a strong event; P90 not max so outliers do not stretch the scale
training_derived.sustained_rotation_dps: P99 of gyro_mag_mean over the same non-accident training windows

rejected_percentile_recipe.why_rejected: hi < lo: simulated hard braking loses more speed per second than accident windows

engineering_assumptions.note: chosen from physical reasoning before examining held-out data; weights < 0.5 each so no single sensor channel can exceed 35 points (MEDIUM)

provenance.severity_accuracy: not computed: the dataset has no ground-truth severity labels
